The curve buyer count (389) and low top-3 share (7.7%) suggest a dispersed holder base rather than a few wallets.

But the recent action argues against entry now. The coin is down 62% from its 30-minute high and returned -40% over the last 15 minutes, with net flow of -18 SOL and sellers (1,283) well outnumbering the flow of new capital. The sell-to-buy ratio of 0.87 in the early window shows early buyers were already exiting. A 32.7% bundle share and a launch bot present are further signs of manufactured early activity. Pool depth of 127 SOL means a $20 ticket faces meaningful impact and a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost.

I see no case that real demand will hold for the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip.
